scope: SDL window/input loader, raw GLES2 quad/texture renderer, viewport geometry, strict build/staging scaffolding
adaptations: Extracted only Point, Rect and Viewport; removed launcher settings, layout, services, JSON and curl.
Changed logical design space from 1920x1080 to 960x540.
Removed FreeType and all font discovery/rasterization.
Removed unconditional launcher artwork loads; preload only immediate PNG files in the supplied asset directory, keyed by filename stem.
Added named image loading, imageSize, hasImage and sprite source rectangles, with nearest texture filtering.
Reduced shader modes to solid and textured quads; retained optional rounded rectangle/stroke geometry.
Always require real SDL2 SDK headers; removed the desktop ABI declaration fallback.

Retained real ARM cross-toolchain checks and non-overwriting staging. A separate explicit staging helper bundles only SDL-webOS and its required pinned PNG codec, with licenses; no platform libraries or fonts are copied.
